schedules.name: Weekend results and performance review
schedules.when: Monday 08:30 Europe/London (GitHub Actions cron, UTC entries for GMT and BST; can queue up to an hour). Email delivery task Monday 10:09 Europe/London.

schedules.name: Midweek fixture analysis
schedules.when: Monday 12:30 Europe/London (GitHub Actions). Email delivery task Monday 14:09 Europe/London.
schedules.window: Monday to Thursday of the current week, fixtures not yet kicked off
schedules.outputs: reports/midweek/YYYY-MM-DD/ (english, european, combined PDFs + CSV + JSON), reports/chatgpt_review/chatgpt_review_YYYY-MM-DD_midweek.md

schedules.name: Weekend fixture analysis
schedules.when: Thursday 08:30 Europe/London (GitHub Actions). Email delivery task Thursday 10:09 Europe/London.
schedules.window: Friday to Sunday of the coming weekend

mechanics: Each run is a GitHub Actions job (.github/workflows/football.yml): fetch football.db from branch data, py download.py --results (API-Football, the only API step), python run_v4.py <mode>, btts_audit.py and write_manifest.py, commit reports/data/logs/runs to main, push the slim database to branch data. reports/manifests/latest_<mode>.json says whether the run completed. A separate Claude scheduled task then reads the repository and emails Rob. No Friday or Saturday runs; manual runs via workflow_dispatch.
outputs_note: Each run also writes reports/manifests/<run_id>.json (completion manifest) and, for midweek/weekend/range, reports/btts_audit/<date>/ and reports/chatgpt_review/btts_audit_review_<date>_<mode>.md (independent BTTS assessment, production verdict unchanged).
